scenicChapters.title: Stelvio Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 71 km this is Stelvio Pass, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

places-lavagnone-benedictine-convent-of-.story: A 409 km round trip from Desenzano del Garda - roughly 7 h 03 in the saddle.
